paper.title_en: General relativistic limit of f(R) gravity in the horizon scale of black hole
paper.abstract_en: The environment of the Galactic Centre (GC) black hole, Sgr A* gives us new opportunities to test black hole physics and deviation from General Relativity. In this analytical study we calculate null geodesics around the GC black hole for the recently developed stationary, axisymmetric and vacuum metric of f(R) gravity theory. We study the impact of scalaron degree of freedom of f(R) gravity theory on size and shape of the black hole shadow. A minimum bound of $10^{-17}$ eV for scalaron mass has been obtained by using $1 σ$ upper bounds on deviation parameter measured by the Keck telescope and the VLT. Scalarons lighter than this bound are found to increase shadow size beyond that measured by the Event Horizon Telescope. We calculate shadow displacement and asymmetry and infer that $10^{-16}$ eV scalarons which produce exact Kerr sized shadow yield 6\% departure from Kerr quadrupole. From asymmetry we infer preservation of black hole no-hair theorem for such scalaron mass and further examine possibility of violation of the theorem. The same mass scale is found to reproduce the PPN parameter ($γ$) constrained in the weak field limit of the solar system. Gravitational identifiers, the Kretschmann scalar ($κ$) and gravitational potential ($φ$) have been used to infer scalaron masses in the regime of S-stars near Sgr A* which are found to be consistent with the limits obtained by using shadow scales. We ensure existence of an appropriate general relativistic limit of f(R) gravity scalaron mass in the horizon scale of the black hole.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文研究了f(R)引力理论在黑洞视界尺度上的广义相对论极限，通过计算银心黑洞的阴影和偏转来约束标量场质量，并讨论了无毛定理的保持问题，适合作为广义相对论基础方向的精选论文。
decision.title_zh: 黑洞视界尺度下f(R)引力的广义相对论极限
decision.abstract_zh: 银河系中心（GC）黑洞Sgr A*的环境为我们提供了检验黑洞物理和广义相对论偏离的新机会。在这项分析性研究中，我们针对最近发展的f(R)引力理论的稳态、轴对称、真空度规，计算了围绕GC黑洞的零测地线。我们研究了f(R)引力理论的标量场自由度对黑洞阴影大小和形状的影响。通过使用凯克望远镜和VLT测量的偏离参数的1σ上限，我们得到了标量场质量的最小界限为$10^{-17}$ eV。我们发现，比这个界限更轻的标量场会使阴影大小增加到超过事件视界望远镜测量的值。我们计算了阴影位移和不对称性，并推断出产生精确克尔大小的阴影的$10^{-16}$ eV标量场导致6%的克尔四极矩偏离。从不对称性我们推断出对于这种标量场质量，黑洞无毛定理得以保持，并进一步检查了定理被违反的可能性。发现相同的质量尺度可以再现太阳系弱场极限中约束的PPN参数（$γ$）。引力标识符，即Kretschmann标量（$κ$）和引力势（$φ$），已被用于推断Sgr A*附近S星区域中的标量场质量，发现这些质量与通过阴影尺度获得的限制一致。我们确保了f(R)引力标量场质量在黑洞视界尺度上存在适当的广义相对论极限。
